description: This CSS file contains styling rules and variables for a Tic Tac Toe game's frontend, including theme management for light and dark modes, layout styles, and responsive design adjustments.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container class for the app, centers the content with responsive background color and text color.

classes.name: game-container
classes.description: Styles for the game container, including padding, background color, and box shadow.

classes.name: game-title
classes.description: Styles for the game title, including margins, color, and font size.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Styles for displaying game status, including margins and font properties.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Styles for the game board, including border properties.

classes.name: board-row
classes.description: Display styling for a row of squares in the board.

classes.name: board-square
classes.description: Styling for each square on the board, including size, font properties, and hover effects.

classes.name: reset-button
classes.description: Styles for the reset button, including margin, padding, and transition effects.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Styles for the theme toggle button, adjusting properties based on screen size.
